verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt file at the vendor's own domain (zoho.com/llms.txt), so an agent has an agent-oriented entry point. That file appears to be a suite-level Zoho overview, and nothing shows it covers Zoho Invoice or its API docs. The Markdown version of the Invoice API docs returned 404, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any candidate path. missing for 10: Invoice-specific llms.txt or llms-full.txt content, Markdown or agent-readable versions of the Invoice API docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of agent usability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.zoho.com/llms.txt # Zoho
Zoho offers a suite of online productivity and collaboration applications.
